The wood appears dark and polished, possibly mahogany or oak. The structure is complex with curved architectural details at the top.

The reflections on the glass are inconsistent. Some panes show clear reflections of the room, while others seem opaque or show distorted textures that don't match the environment. The grid lines of the mullions waver slightly.
The text on the book spines is largely illegible gibberish. While some look like letters, many are melted shapes or nonsensical characters, a common AI artifact.
The vertical line of the rightmost edge seems to warp slightly inward and then outward, lacking the straightness expected of a rigid wooden structure.
